landing.heroSub: Replace manual PDF creation with a secure, role-based workflow. Generate, sign, deliver and verify official documents with cryptographic tamper-proof integrity.
landing.featuresSub: From template creation to cryptographically verified delivery — all in one platform.
landing.feat1Desc: Build reusable templates with placeholder syntax for HR, Finance, Academic, and Procurement documents. Supports conditional blocks and loops.
landing.feat2Desc: Generate one document or hundreds at once. Bulk jobs run as background tasks with real-time progress — no waiting, no blocking.
landing.feat3Desc: Approvers confirm identity via a 6-digit one-time code. HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic proof is embedded — fully non-repudiable.
landing.feat4Desc: Every PDF footer contains a QR code with its SHA-256 hash. Anyone can verify authenticity on the public page — no login required.
landing.feat5Desc: Send signed PDFs directly to recipients via branded email. Generate expiring secure download links and track every access.
landing.feat6Desc: Every action — generate, preview, sign, deliver, verify — is logged immutably with user, IP, timestamp, and document snapshot.
landing.howSub: A complete, auditable workflow — every step recorded and traceable.
landing.step1Desc: Choose from HR, Finance, Academic or Procurement templates
landing.step2Desc: Enter a Record ID or upload a CSV to fill all placeholders
landing.step3Desc: SHA-256 hash computed and QR code embedded in the footer
landing.step4Desc: Send to an Approver with a secure email review link
landing.step5Desc: Approver confirms identity via a 6-digit one-time code
landing.step6Desc: Email the signed PDF — anyone can verify via QR scan
landing.securitySub: Every document is fingerprinted with SHA-256 at generation time. Any external modification — even a single character — is instantly flagged on the public verification page.
landing.secChain1: Document generated and raw PDF created
landing.secChain2: SHA-256 hash computed and stored in database
landing.secChain3: QR code with hash embedded in PDF footer
landing.rolesSub: Precisely scoped permissions for every type of user.
landing.ctaSub: Verify its authenticity in seconds — no account needed. Scan the QR code on the document or enter the Document ID to confirm it is genuine and untampered.
landing.ctaFree: Free — no login required — instant result
landing.finalSub: Join DocuVault's digital transformation. Generate, sign, and deliver official documents in minutes — not days.

footer.description: A centralized, role-based document automation platform — replacing manual PDF creation with a secure, auditable, and tamper-proof workflow for DocuVault.

verify.title: Document Verification
verify.sub: Verify the authenticity of any official DocuVault document using cryptographic SHA-256 hash verification.
verify.hashMismatch: Hash mismatch — document may be tampered
verify.shaVerified: SHA-256 hash verified. This document has not been modified since it was generated.
verify.shaMismatch: Hash mismatch detected. This document may have been altered or corrupted externally.
verify.scanQrDesc: Point your camera at the QR code printed on the document
verify.cameraPermDenied: Camera permission denied. Please allow camera access in your browser settings.
verify.cameraNotFound: No camera found on this device.
verify.cameraError: Could not start camera. Please check permissions and try again.
